review.instruction: Confirm the peer set, exact child goals, owned scopes and coordinator done-when map equal the digest-frozen snapshot with no missing, extra or reassigned peer.
Resolve each peer only through its declared original live session or verified close-success bundle; messages, copied receipts and inferred status may locate but never replace proof.
Verify every original child goal has accepted evidence bound to the frozen goal and terminal state, and every coordinator done-when line has an owning proved peer.
For every delivered repository boundary, verify the declared evidence at the exact current repository head and valid ancestry. Do not combine evidence from different heads into a synthetic delivery.

failurePolicy: Report the exact peer, goal or head whose original proof is missing or stale. Re-read only newly supplied evidence within the bounded feedback loop; never modify a peer to make verification pass.
